short.text: Russell Allen was a rotation linebacker for Jacksonville who played in all {{2013.regular.games}} regular-season games in 2013 and started beside Daryl Smith when Paul Posluszny was out. He was dependable when his job expanded on a week's notice, brought value as a communicator and contributed on the coverage units. Creating pressure and man coverage were the weakest parts of his game.

transactions.text: Signed a three-year contract with Jacksonville
Traded by Jacksonville to Arizona for Arizona's 2015 fourth-round pick
